locations.note: A curator's murder in the Louvre sets symbologist Robert Langdon on the Grail trail.
The curator Saunière is found dead in the Grand Gallery, and Langdon reads the clues he left among the paintings.
Langdon reaches the church after Silas, knocks out a monk attacking the nun Marguerite and finds the tablet with Job 38:11 under the gnomon.
Langdon and Neveu take refuge at the home of the Grail historian Sir Leigh Teabing, where Silas is subdued.
Clues lead Langdon and Neveu to Temple Church and Westminster Abbey in London.
The Templar church is the next clue; in its courtyard Remy turns on Langdon and Neveu.
Remy captures Langdon and Neveu and takes them to Teabing, the Teacher; Teabing shoots Remy, Langdon destroys the cryptex and Teabing is arrested.
Neveu's grandmother tells them at Rosslyn that the Grail is in France, and the clue points back to the Rose Line in Paris.
A key leads Neveu to the Depository Bank of Zurich.
They land at Biggin Hill and head for Temple Church.

routes.name: Langdon and Neveu
routes.note: From the Louvre murder to the Rose Line under the Louvre Pyramid.
